purpose: Inspect exact signatures and instantiate lattice hypotheses after the clean library build.
output:
N2_v1 : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ),
  2 ≤ ∑ j, ν j →
    (Summable fun l => ‖higherKernel ν ↑↑l‖) ∧
      (∀ q ∉ L, Summable fun l => ‖higherKernel ν (q + ↑l)‖) ∧
        HasSumLocallyUniformlyOn (fun l q => higherKernel ν (q + ↑l)) (higherLatticeSum L ν) (↑L)ᶜ ∧
          ∀ (ω : ↥L), ∀ q ∉ L, higherElliptic L ν (q + ↑ω) = higherElliptic L ν q
N3_v1 : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ),
  2 ≤ ∑ j, ν j → Even (∑ j, ν j) → eisensteinCoefficient L ν = 0
def MathResearch.Fueter.spatialMultiIndex : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → Fin 4 → ℕ :=
fun ν => Fin.cons 0 ν
def MathResearch.Fueter.higherKernel : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun ν => multiIndexPartial (spatialMultiIndex ν) kernel
def MathResearch.Fueter.eisensteinCoefficient : Submodule ℤ ℍ → (Fin 3 → ℕ) → ℍ :=
fun L ν => ∑' (l : { l // l ≠ 0 }), higherKernel ν ↑↑l
def MathResearch.Fueter.higherLatticeSum : Submodule ℤ ℍ → (Fin 3 → ℕ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun L ν q => ∑' (l : ↥L), higherKernel ν (q + ↑l)
def MathResearch.Fueter.higherElliptic : Submodule ℤ ℍ → (Fin 3 → ℕ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun L ν q => higherLatticeSum L ν q - eisensteinCoefficient L ν
'MathResearch.Fueter.N2_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'MathResearch.Fueter.N3_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
